label: Bible Study
prompt: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and _____ about many things:
verse: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
note: Martha's busy kitchen — Jesus says only one thing is needful, and Mary had chosen it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church _____ such as should be saved.
verse: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.
note: The early church kept praising and growing — new believers added not yearly or weekly, but daily.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was _____, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And the LORD said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.
verse: And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And the LORD said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.
note: The youngest son, called in from the sheep: ruddy, with a beautiful countenance — and God said, 'This is he.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Now ye are the body of Christ, and _____ in particular.
verse: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
note: Paul's body metaphor lands: the eye can't fire the hand, and every member of the church matters.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But there is a God in heaven that _____ secrets, and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Thy dream, and the visions of thy head upon thy bed, are these;
verse: But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Thy dream, and the visions of thy head upon thy bed, are these;
note: Before Nebuchadnezzar, Daniel took no credit at all: 'there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets.'
